experience.faq_description: Have something else in mind? Send a photo and let’s talk it through.

faqs.question: Can I combine a few jobs in one visit?
faqs.answer: Send your full list. We can discuss what can be grouped together, the materials needed and how much time to allow.

faqs.question: Can you install equipment I already own?
faqs.answer: Yes. Share the brands, model numbers and photos of the space so compatibility, mounting and wiring needs can be discussed.

faqs.question: Where do you work?
faqs.answer: BrightLink serves the Cleveland, Ohio area. Include your city or neighborhood so Thomas can confirm travel and availability.

faqs.question: What electrical work can you help with?
faqs.answer: Minor upgrades include fixtures, ceiling fans, receptacles and doorbell transformers. Additional outlets depend on the existing setup. Photos help confirm suitability and applicable requirements before scheduling.

faqs.question: How much will my project cost?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the job, materials and existing setup. Send your project details for a conversation about scope and pricing before work begins.
